result.title: GRACE: Controlled Evidence Interventions for Diagnosing and Improving Knowledge Integration in GraphRAG
result.comment: pages, 3 numbered figures, and five graph-state illustrations. Submitted to SOICT 2026
result.summary: GraphRAG combines a language model's parametric knowledge with retrieved graph evidence, yet aggregate accuracy cannot show whether failures stem from missing paths, distractors, or conflicts with model knowledge. We introduce GRACE, a benchmark built by executing LC-QuAD 2.0 queries over Wikidata and applying four controlled interventions to each evidence subgraph: severing a support path, adding type-compatible distractors, attaching high-degree hubs, and replacing the supported answer with a counterfactual entity. Questions and option positions remain fixed across the five states. The validated benchmark contains 4,028 questions and 20,140 question-graph pairs. These comparisons reveal that question-only routing cannot distinguish evidence states, while relevance guidance can improve answerable states yet hurt when the support path is severed: relevant facts may not jointly suffice to answer. We propose QCFSE-SA, which combines typed local attention, global graph attention, and question-conditioned evidence guidance with a calibrated graph-support gate. With the factual context and generator held fixed, it improves controlled-state accuracy from 57.17% to 62.78% (+5.61 points; question-clustered 95% CI [+5.04, +6.17]) and broken-state accuracy from 55.41% to 67.85%. Over-abstention on semantic distractors remains an open challenge.

AI.brief_summary: 构建 GraphRAG 基准 GRACE，对每个证据子图施加切断支撑路径、加入类型兼容干扰项、接入高度数枢纽和用反事实实体替换答案四种受控干预，并提出结合局部/全局图注意力、问题条件证据引导与校准支撑门控的 QCFSE-SA 模型。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「相关事实未必联合充分」的发现及校准图支撑门控，可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、支持组合与停止/弃答决策；但该工作非视觉、非 latent，迁移可行性需进一步判断。
